title: I Left the Cafe Review With the Wrong-Name Latte Photo

parts.text: I posted the review at 11:19 a.m. with the wrong-name latte photo and the receipt that said mine. The cup said MARA. I am not Mara. I was twenty-six, regular, standing at a pickup that made me look like I owned the wait. I photographed the cup, the receipt, and the ticket still. The shop refunded the drink and reprinted the ticket with my name. I keep the Mara photo. The pickup finally knows a name from a guess.

social.video_title: The latte said Mara and the receipt said me — Part 1/1
social.description: Wrong-name cup, matching receipt, a ticket still. They reprinted my name. Has a cafe ever guessed you into someone else?
